# GitHub Copilot Instructions

The rules for this project live in one place and are shared by every AI assistant:

- [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — project overview, commands, architecture, coding standards and safety rules. Read it
  first.
- [`.agents/instructions/`](../.agents/instructions/) — topic guides: `drupal.md`, `php.md`, `twig.md`, `js.md`,
  `git.md`. Read the guide for the area you touch before changing code.
- [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/) — step-by-step procedures: create a service or a plugin, refactor to
  dependency injection, review performance, write a commit message.

`.github/instructions/` maps file types to those guides; `.github/prompts/` exposes the skills as prompts.
